snippet.title: Bahast 1.4.0 — The Tides of Power | Official Update Trailer
snippet.description:
Bahast 1.4.0 — The Tides of Power arrives October 29, 2026.

Play Bahast on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4769520/

Rebuild your character with new passive wheels, class archetypes and build-changing keystones. Discover 10 new skills, 18 new Support Jewels, painted skill animations and 40 new Uniques.

Find crafting Reagents earlier, expand your Skill Parchment’s Support sockets and enter the Culling Sea. Face Klagmor, the Drowned Champion, and pursue the Gilded Vellum that can unlock a sixth Support socket.

Existing Characters receive a one-time free passive reset. Your saves carry over.

0:00 Tides of Power: build diversity
0:26 Class archetypes and passives
1:04 Skill animations and new skills
1:23 Reagents and Parchment sockets
1:36 New Uniques
1:48 The Culling Sea and Gilded Vellum
2:02 Klagmor, the Drowned Champion

Official website: https://www.bahastgame.com/
Full patch notes arrive with the update.
Developed by FC Tech Labs.

#Bahast #TidesOfPower #IdleARPG
